decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording that regular Enter is enabled for the date field, so no additional or amended Event is needed.
Allowing regular Enter as a date-entry method does not change field labels, help-text content, locations, or persistence.
The date field's calendar dropdown and regular Enter input are unrelated to the checklist-and-dropdown control configuration.
Adding regular Enter input to the date field does not change when or how placeholder text clears.
The date-entry method does not alter the visible instructional cue used to identify editable fields.
The source decision concerns date input and does not modify preservation of Title-field formatting during interaction.
The source specifies an additional date-entry interaction but does not change the general field architecture or editable-text mechanism.
Regular Enter input for a date field does not change automatic text wrapping or adjacent-column stability.
The source changes the date-entry method but leaves the Danish date placeholder and other user-facing text unchanged.
The date field's input method does not affect text-to-border padding.
Regular Enter input in the date field is distinct from Enter creating a new bullet in designated bullet controls.
Adding regular Enter date input does not change alignment of the Board Meeting Item and Title field.
